rows.summary: Fix paginate to treat page 1 as starting at index 0 (not 2), so page 1 returns the first chunk.

rows.kind: sort: direction, tie-break and no mutation
rows.summary: Fix rank to sort descending by score (highest first), then ascending by name for ties, using a copy so input is untouched.

rows.kind: defaults override the caller and mutate
rows.summary: Fix withDefaults to merge without mutating input and without letting defaults overwrite caller values: use Object.assign({}, DEFAULTS, opts) so opts wins and a fresh object is returned.
Fix memoization to key on all arguments instead of only the first, so different second args don't return stale cached value.
Make loadAll await all the fetchOne promises so it resolves to the list of results instead of a list of promises.
Update isEmail regex to require at least one dot in the domain part after @, so 'a@b' is now invalid while valid cases like 'a@b.co' still pass.
Rename fetchUser to getUser in its definition (users.js), export, import, and call site (greeting.js) under apps/web/src. Tests already updated.

Fix get() to refresh the entry's position in the Map (making it most-recent) so that a just-read entry is not evicted on next set when full. This matches the intended LRU behavior shown by the 'read refreshes' test.
Fix formatDuration to correctly compute remaining minutes and seconds after hours.
Update parseAge to throw RangeError('invalid age') for non-numeric, negative, >150 or empty input (while valid 0-150 ints return as-is).
Fix subtotal to multiply price by qty (default 1) so buying multiples charges correctly.
Make removeAt return a new array (using slice+concat) instead of mutating the input with splice.
